cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative fixed-state relaxed force allocation, not Tesla data. At zero residual yaw moment and per-side capacity 12 kN, total forward force is 24 without jet, 34 with centred 10 kN jet, 26.5 with jet at lateral offset 0.6 m. With per-side capacity 8 kN, totals are 16, 26, 18.5 kN. Half-track is 0.8 m; yaw correction gives up 7.5 kN of tyre force in both comparisons. Same installed mass and bounds.
